title: Fem 2D Interactive Feature Complete
description: Make the fem2d artifact editor (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏗️fem/🗿️artifacts/◻️2d) feature complete for interactive use on the React dev lane (port 6086): an artifact tree/outliner panel listing nodes, elements, supports, loads, load cases, combinations, materials, sections and results; viewport/tree selection with an inspector panel whose editable controls (numbers, selects, toggles, sliders) dispatch real document mutations (move node, edit load magnitude, material/section properties, support fixity, analysis settings); an animated deformation visualisation with a timestep/phase slider, play/pause and speed; plus the missing update/remove mutations and tests. Bookkeeping is manual on disk because the repo MCP failed to connect (connection closed) at session start.
